components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant onboarding and confirmation action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #C23F35; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity 90ms, transform 90ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { opacity: .92; } .ds-button-primary:active { opacity: .86; transform: scale(.98); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23F35; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A clear secondary choice without a competing fill.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 50px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #171717; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #171717; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity 90ms, transform 90ms; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: #F5F5F3; } .ds-button-outline:active { opacity: .86; transform: scale(.98); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23F35; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The neutral single-line field used in onboarding.
components.css: .ds-text-field { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid #E5E5E2; border-radius: 12px; background: #F5F5F3; color: #171717; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; } .ds-text-field:hover { border-color: #6F6F6B; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23F35; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Moment
components.description: An inset, quiet surface that gives a private note room to breathe.
components.html: Wish you were here for this.
components.css: .ds-note-moment { min-height: 170px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #E5E5E2; border-radius: 12px; background: #F7F7F5; color: #222220; display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-note-moment p { margin: 0; font-size: 21px; line-height: 30px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Selected Reaction Chip
components.description: A compact record of a reaction that actually exists.
components.css: .ds-reaction-chip { min-width: 44px; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #C23F35; border-radius: 999px; background: #FFF0ED; color: #C23F35; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-reaction-chip:hover { opacity: .86; } .ds-reaction-chip:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-reaction-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23F35; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reaction Tray
components.description: The temporary hold-and-slide emoji chooser above a moment.
components.css: .ds-reaction-tray { min-height: 58px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #E5E5E2; border-radius: 999px; background: #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.12); } .ds-reaction-tray button { min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; font-size: 24px; transition: background 90ms, transform 140ms; } .ds-reaction-tray button:hover { background: #FFF0ED; } .ds-reaction-tray button:active { transform: translateY(-7px) scale(1.55); } .ds-reaction-tray button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23F35; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: App Navigation
components.description: A flat two-destination tab bar organized around the lifted send action.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 24px; border-top: 1px solid #E5E5E2; background: #FFFFFF; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-around; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; min-height: 52px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #6F6F6B; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; font-size: 23px; } .ds-nav-item span { font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { color: #C23F35; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible, .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23F35; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-send { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-top: -18px; border: 1px solid #C23F35; border-radius: 999px; background: #C23F35; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 28px; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.14); } .ds-send:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-send:active { opacity: .78; }

narrative.overview:
Moments should feel like a photo or tiny note placed directly into one loved person's hand. The interface borrows the immediate legibility and media confidence of Instagram, then removes public-social density: no metrics, ornamental chrome, or competing calls to action. Photos and personal words are the content; the interface stays quiet around them.

The mood is intimate, calm, cute, and grown-up. Friendly Poppins typography, centered titles, neutral surfaces, and a single deep coral interaction color create warmth without turning the app into a scrapbook. Controls are familiar and native, while the large center send action and gesture-led reaction tray give the product a recognizable rhythm of its own.
keyCharacteristics: Media-first composition with full-width square photos and restrained context.
Flat white or near-neutral surfaces separated by hairlines and tonal shifts.
One accessible deep coral action color, supported by a pale coral selected state.
Friendly Poppins typography with minimal centered titles.
Spacious, centered onboarding with one dominant decision at a time.
Native sheets and platform symbols for focused actions.
Reactions stay hidden until relevant; only reactions that exist remain visible.

rules.name: The One Coral Rule
rules.body: Deep coral is the only general interaction accent. Do not introduce competing blues, purples, or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Media Keeps Its Color Rule
rules.body: The interface stays chromatically restrained so shared photos remain the richest color on the screen.

rules.name: The Friendly Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep titles short and use bold Poppins sparingly; long explanatory copy stays regular weight and secondary color.

rules.name: The Centered Title Rule
rules.body: Center brand headers and spacious onboarding titles. Keep operational content, captions, and form labels left aligned.

rules.name: The One-Handed Send Rule
rules.body: Keep the center send action prominent and keep composer decisions vertically ordered for quick thumb reach.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface persists at rest, prefer tonal contrast or a hairline. Shadows belong to temporary overlays and the singular floating send action.

dos: Do let shared photos and notes occupy the visual center of gravity.
Do use Deep Coral for primary action, active state, the heart reaction, and brand marks.
Do keep headers minimal and centered, then align operational content for fast scanning.
Do use native sheets, safe areas, platform symbols, and accessible 44–48px touch targets.
Do keep onboarding centered, spacious, and limited to one primary decision per screen.
Do provide a tap and accessibility alternative wherever hold-and-slide reveals reactions.
Do keep widgets visually consistent with the in-app moment and route their send actions through the Send sheet's one-time camera launch.
donts: Don't add public-social metrics, engagement counters, follower language, or feed chrome.
Don't introduce competing accent colors, decorative gradients, or scrapbook ornament.
Don't wrap full-width photos in floating cards or persistent shadows.
Don't show an empty reaction row; reactions appear only after someone adds them.
Don't use pills for ordinary fields and containers; reserve them for reactions and compact controls.
Don't let custom motion override native navigation, sheet behavior, or reduced-motion preferences.
